name: Micro and Nano Manufacturing
description:
MEMS,NEMS and nanotechnology have already found many applications in Mechanical Engineering and are projected to be of greater relevance to mechanical systems in future. Objective of the course is to provide the knowledge in emerging manufacturing techniques for producing micro and nano level products. 
An overview of micro and nano mechanical systems and their applications in Mechanical Engineering, MEMS Microfabrication methods, Silicon Micromachining methods, Laser, Electron and Ion beam micromachining methods, Mechanical Micromachining techniques, Nanomanufacturing methods, nanomaterials and nano metrology.
